effective_boundary: The kernel commit of the redaction_profile record: any release decision whose redaction resolution begins after that commit observes the new rules (initial resolution, per-operation re-resolution, and the post-run re-check that invalidates in-flight continuations).
authority: Server-authoritative only: callers name a serving context (redaction_profile_id), the committed rules behind the name decide release, unknown names fail closed, and an omitted name resolves the committed 'default' profile (never an escape).
